policy: No placeholder/fake assets. Status may advance to SOURCE_READY or later only when a non-empty resource file exists.

batches.name: Town shell
batches.exit: All six resources exist, render at required dimensions, and pass VCMI resource lookup.

batches.name: Adventure town shell
batches.exit: Village/castle/capitol and editor animation resources exist and map object opens without missing-resource errors.

batches.name: Core town structures
batches.exit: All registered building animation/border/area resources resolve; selection masks match visible structures.

batches.name: Siege shell
batches.exit: Two tower icons plus complete required CRSG prefix family resolve in siege.

batches.name: Puzzle map family
batches.exit: All 48 prefix-derived puzzle pieces CRP00.png through CRP47.png exist, are non-empty, resolve in VCMI, and reveal in the intended order.

batches.name: T1/T2 creatures
batches.exit: Four battle animation resources and eight icons exist and animate/render in VCMI.

batches.name: Smoke-test heroes
batches.exit: Portrait, specialty, class battle, map/editor hero visuals for the Vaelor/Aveline smoke path all exist and resolve in VCMI.

batches.name: T1/T2 audio
batches.exit: Attack/defend/killed/move/wince audio resolves for all four creatures.

batches.name: Town music
batches.exit: Track loads, loops acceptably, and does not error in town screen.

batches.name: Remaining T3-T7 creatures
batches.exit: T3-T7 base/upgrade battle animations and creature icons exist, are non-empty, and resolve in VCMI.

batches.name: Remaining Crimson heroes
batches.exit: All 16 Crimson hero portrait pairs and specialty icon pairs exist and resolve; B2 smoke-test assets may overlap.

batches.name: Class passive skill art
batches.exit: Blood Command and Crimson Divination icon families exist and resolve at every registered UI size.

batches.name: Crimson Blood Rite spell art
batches.exit: All registered Crimson Blood Rite spell icon resources exist and resolve.

batches.name: Universal spell art
batches.exit: All staged universal counterplay spell icon resources exist and resolve.

batches.name: Remaining T3-T7 audio
batches.exit: Attack/defend/killed/move/wince audio resolves for every T3-T7 base/upgrade creature.

batches.name: Future faction class-passive skill art
batches.exit: All staged Abyss, Veil, Hollow, and Starfall class-passive icon families exist at every registered UI size and resolve before those factions activate.

validation.selectorPolicy: Every selector must match at least one manifest resource. A resource may belong to multiple batches.
